blocks.text:
It was already decreed in the knowledge of Allah Ta'ala. The news that you are the best Ummah was also made known to some of the Prophets. Just as the Prophet ﷺ is the best of all the Prophets, in the same way you are the best Ummah above the other Ummahs. For this Ummah will receive the most honoured and excellent Prophet, and will receive the perfect and everlasting Shari'ah. The door of knowledge and wisdom will be opened for this Ummah. The branches of Iman, deeds and fear of Allah will flourish as a fruit of the effort and sacrifice of this Ummah. This is not restricted to one country, one state or one community. The sphere of activity of this Ummah will encompass the whole world and every class of human life. This community exists in the world only to seek the good of others; as far as possible, this Ummah will bring them and make them stand at the door of Paradise.
(Tafsir Usmani)

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (قُلْ هذِهِ سَبِيلِي أَدْعُو إِلَي اللهِ قف عَلي بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِي۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) say! “This is my (straight) way; I call to Allah; I and those who follow me are upon clear evidence.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتُ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ م يَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَيُقِيمُونَ الصّلَوةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزّكوةَ وَيُطِيعُونَ اللهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ؕ أُولئِكَ سَيَرْحَمُهُمُ اللهُ ؕ إِنَّ اللهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: The believing men and the believing women are helpers of one another; they enjoin good (upon others); from evil
